<style>
/* ─── BASE LAYOUT ─── */
#editorial-product-grid-inner.editorial-product-grid {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: row !important;
    flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
    gap: 60px !important;
    align-items: flex-start !important;
}

.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery {
    width: 100% !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
}

/* Kill zoom trigger */
.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery__trigger {
    display: none !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    width: 0 !important;
    height: 0 !important;
}

/* ─── MAIN SLIDER VIEWPORT ─── */
/* No aspect-ratio here — FlexSlider JS controls height, don't override */
.editorial-gallery-col .flex-viewport {
    width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 4px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    display: block !important;
}

/* Kill all internal slider margins */
.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .woocommerce-product-gallery__wrapper {
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
}

.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .woocommerce-product-gallery__wrapper li {
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
}

.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .woocommerce-product-gallery__wrapper img {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    display: block !important;
    object-fit: cover !important;
}

/* ─── THUMBNAIL STRIP ─── */
/* margin-top: 10px gives the only gap needed */
.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .flex-control-nav {
    margin: 10px 0 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    display: block !important;
}

.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .flex-control-thumbs {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
    gap: 6px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    list-style: none !important;
    width: 100% !important;
}

.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .flex-control-thumbs li {
    flex: 0 0 calc(20% - 5px) !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
}

.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .flex-control-thumbs li img {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    aspect-ratio: 1 !important;
    object-fit: cover !important;
    border-radius: 3px !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
    opacity: 0.6 !important;
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease !important;
    border: 1.5px solid transparent !important;
    display: block !important;
}

.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .flex-control-thumbs li img.flex-active,
.editorial-gallery-col .woocommerce-product-gallery .flex-control-thumbs li img:hover {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    border-color: #688F9D !important;
}

/* ─── RESET ELEMENTOR WIDGET MARGINS ─── */
.editorial-details-col .elementor-widget {
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
}

/* ─── TITLE ─── */
.editorial-details-col .elementor-widget-theme-post-title h1 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif !important;
    font-size: 48px !important;
    line-height: 1.05 !important;
    color: #0E1B30 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    margin: 0 0 12px !important;
}

/* ─── PRICE ─── */
.editorial-details-col .woocommerce-product-price .price {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif !important;
    font-size: 26px !important;
    color: #688F9D !important;
    font-style: italic !important;
    margin: 0 0 20px !important;
    display: block !important;
}

/* ─── SHORT DESCRIPTION ─── */
.editorial-details-col .woocommerce-product-details__short-description {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 300 !important;
    font-size: 17px !important;
    line-height: 1.65 !important;
    color: rgba(14, 27, 48, 0.7) !important;
    margin: 0 0 28px !important;
}

/* ─── CART ROW ─── */
.editorial-details-col form.cart {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    gap: 16px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
}

.editorial-details-col .quantity {
    background: #F9F9F9 !important;
    border: 1px solid #E5E5E5 !important;
    border-radius: 100px !important;
    height: 50px !important;
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    padding: 0 16px !important;
}

.editorial-details-col button.single_add_to_cart_button {
    background: #688F9D !important;
    color: #FFFFFF !important;
    padding: 0 32px !important;
    height: 50px !important;
    border-radius: 100px !important;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: 2px !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    border: none !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
    transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease !important;
}

.editorial-details-col button.single_add_to_cart_button:hover {
    background: #4f7280 !important;
    transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

/* ─── LABEL ─── */
.editorial-label-wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 8px !important;
    padding-top: 0 !important;
}

.editorial-line {
    width: 24px;
    height: 1px;
    background: #688F9D;
    opacity: 0.6;
}

.editorial-label {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    color: #688F9D;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   LAPTOP  (1025px – 1440px)
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 1025px) and (max-width: 1440px) {
    #editorial-product-grid-inner.editorial-product-grid {
        gap: 48px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .elementor-widget-theme-post-title h1 {
        font-size: 40px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .woocommerce-product-price .price {
        font-size: 24px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .woocommerce-product-details__short-description {
        font-size: 16px !important;
    }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   TABLET  (768px – 1024px)
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    #editorial-product-grid-inner.editorial-product-grid {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        gap: 40px !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        text-align: left !important;
        display: flex !important;
    }
    #editorial-gallery-col-wrap.editorial-gallery-col,
    #editorial-details-col-wrap.editorial-details-col {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 600px !important;
        min-width: 100% !important;
    }
    .editorial-gallery-col .flex-viewport {
        max-height: 520px !important;
        border-radius: 4px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .elementor-widget-theme-post-title h1 {
        font-size: 42px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .woocommerce-product-price .price {
        font-size: 24px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .woocommerce-product-details__short-description {
        font-size: 16px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col button.single_add_to_cart_button {
        flex: 1 !important;
    }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   PHONE  (≤767px)
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .stillness-editorial-main-section {
        padding: 24px 20px 48px !important;
    }
    #editorial-product-grid-inner.editorial-product-grid {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        gap: 28px !important;
        align-items: flex-start !important;
        text-align: left !important;
        display: flex !important;
    }
    #editorial-gallery-col-wrap.editorial-gallery-col,
    #editorial-details-col-wrap.editorial-details-col {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        min-width: 100% !important;
    }
    .editorial-gallery-col .flex-viewport {
        border-radius: 8px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .elementor-widget-theme-post-title h1 {
        font-size: 32px !important;
        line-height: 1.1 !important;
        margin: 0 0 8px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .woocommerce-product-price .price {
        font-size: 22px !important;
        margin: 0 0 16px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .woocommerce-product-details__short-description {
        font-size: 15px !important;
        line-height: 1.6 !important;
        margin: 0 0 20px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col form.cart {
        flex-direction: row !important;
        gap: 12px !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col .quantity {
        height: 46px !important;
        padding: 0 14px !important;
        flex-shrink: 0 !important;
    }
    .editorial-details-col button.single_add_to_cart_button {
        height: 46px !important;
        flex: 1 !important;
        padding: 0 20px !important;
        font-size: 10px !important;
        letter-spacing: 1.5px !important;
    }
    .editorial-label {
        font-size: 10px !important;
        letter-spacing: 2px !important;
    }
}
</style>
